title: Linking Cryptoasset Attribution Tags to Knowledge Graph Entities: An LLM-based Approach

live_model.evidence: Sec. 5.1: 'GPT-4o, GPT-3.5 Turbo ... employed in their specific versions: gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 and gpt-4o-2024-05-13'; 'For all models, we set the temperature to 0'.

prompt.location: Figure 4 (base prompt template: SYS, FEW-SHOT, INPUT, OUT parts); Table 2 (ten template configurations)
prompt.note: Five-shot examples come from the 25-sample train split.

claim.metric: macro F1, candidate selection, GraphSense TagPack validation set, five-shot template 7
claim.location: Table 4, row GPT4o, Five-Shot columns (T=7, F1 0.939, Acc 0.983)

data.source: GraphSense TagPack datasets and code at github.com/ravice234/cryptoasset-attribution-tag-linker; validation split 771 tags

notes: Model inputs are candidate sets produced by the BM25-based blocking stage (Table 3); reproducing them is the soft gap. The paper reports one GPT-4o run at $3.36.

resolution.plan: Model inputs are candidate sets from concept filtering plus BM25 blocking (k candidates) and five-shot examples from the 25-tag train split; regenerate both with the released code and data, build template 7 (Figure 4 / Table 2), run gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at temperature 0 on the 771-tag validation split and compare macro F1 0.939 / accuracy 0.983 (Table 4). Fallback: re-implement BM25 blocking with rank_bm25 per Sec. 4.1 on the GraphSense TagPacks.
resolution.approximation: Candidate sets may differ if the TagPack data changed or blocking is re-implemented.
